title: Lovely Smoky Uruguayan Beef Hash
description: A smoky and dense Uruguayan dish featuring Sichuan pepper, perfect for curing hangovers, made Whole30-friendly and cooked to perfection in a ramekin using an air fryer.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, Sichuan pepper, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until they are evenly distributed throughout the beef mixture.
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a flat round patty.
Place a ramekin in the air fryer basket and brush the inside with coconut oil.
Add a beef patty to the ramekin and cook for 10 minutes, then flip the patty and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining beef patties.
Once the beef is cooked, remove it from the ramekin and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
